verses.text: Ixlajwi chi' haxo masanil heb' anima ix ak'anoch winhaj Joacaz yuninal winhaj Josías chi' reyal t'a Jerusalén sk'exulok winh smam chi'.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 23 ab'il sk'inal winh, oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh.

Ha winh sreyal Egipto ix ik'anel winh t'a reyal chi'. Ix yak'anoch k'e'en tumin winh sreyal Egipto chi' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá chi' yik syak'an 75 quintal k'e'en plata heb' yet' oxe' arroba k'e'en oro.

Haxo winhaj Eliaquim yuk'tak winhaj Joacaz chi' ix ochkan reyal t'a Judá chi' yuj winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ix k'exchaj sb'i winhaj Eliaquim chi' yuj winh, Joacim ix sb'i'ejkan winh, haxo winhaj Joacaz chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winh sreyal Egipto chi'.
Ayik ix och winhaj Joacim chi' reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová Dios.
Haxo winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia ix jawi yak' owal yet' winh, ix tzek'ji winh t'a k'e'en cadena, ix ik'jib'at winh t'a Babilonia chi'.
Hanhejtona' ix yik'b'at juntzanh yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a yol stemplo sdiosal t'a Babilonia chi'.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joacim chi' yet' tastak te yajb'entak ix sk'ulej winh yet' juntzanhxo chukal ix sk'ulej winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Israel yet' heb' yik Judá. Haxo winhaj Joaquín yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joaquín yak'an reyal, 18 ab'il sk'inal winh. Oxe' ujal yet' lajunhexo k'uhal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha t'a b'ab'el uj yik jun ab'il chi', ix yal winhaj Nabucodonosor to tz'ik'jib'at winhaj Joaquín chi' t'a Babilonia yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' te caro stojol ay t'a skajnub' Jehová. Haxo winhaj Sedequías ix ak'ji'och reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén sk'exulok winhaj Joaquín chi'. Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', sk'ab' yok sb'a winh yet' winhaj Joaquín chi'.
Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', 21 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Maj sna sb'a sk'o'ol winh yuj skachnab'il ix schek Jehová yal winh schekab' aj Jeremías.

Ijan ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor yalani, haton b'aj ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Dios to junnhej ix yutej spensar winh yet' winh. Jun'elnhej ix yak' pitb'okel spensar winh, majxo yal sk'o'ol winh ix meltzaj t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Hanhejtona' masanil heb' winh yajal t'a Judá chi', heb' winh sacerdote yet' masanil heb' anima, ix te k'e wal cha'anh heb' sk'ulan chukal te yajb'entak. Ha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il ix sb'eyb'alej heb', ix yixtanel skajnub' Jehová heb', haton jun sik'b'ilel yuj t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' smam yicham heb', ix scheknhejkot heb' schekab' yik tzul kachji heb', yujto tz'ok' sk'o'ol t'a schonhab' yet' t'a skajnub' chi'.

Palta tonhej ix stzetzej heb' schekab' Dios chi' heb', malaj yelk'och tas ix yal heb' t'a sat heb'. Ix b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb' schekab' Dios chi', masanto ix em wal yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh schonhab' chi', majxo yal-laj yoch wa'an.

Ixlajwi chi', ix chekjikot winh sreyal heb' aj Babilonia chi' yuj Jehová, ix jawi winh yak' owal yet' heb' aj Judá chi'. Ix miljicham heb' kelemtak t'a k'e'en espada t'a yamak'il skajnub' Dios. Manhxa jab'ok sniwank'olal heb' t'a heb' kelemtak chi' yet' t'a heb' ix kob'estak, t'a heb' icham anima manhxa yip. Ix ak'ji'och heb' smasanil t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey chi' yuj Jehová.

Masanil yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Dios, niwak yet' kotak, jantaknhej tas ay t'a skajnub' chi' yet' masanil sb'eyumal winh rey yet' yik heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh rey chi', pilan ix yik'b'at winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Babilonia.
Ix snhusankantz'a skajnub' Dios chi' heb', ix smak'ankanem lanhnaj smuro'al Jerusalén chi' heb'. Ix snhusantz'a spalacio winh rey heb', ix smak'anpoj masanil tas caro stojol heb'.

Haxo heb' maj miljokcham t'a owal chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi'. Ix ochkan heb' chekab'ok t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal winh, masanto ayik ix ak'ji ganar Babilonia chi' yuj heb' aj Persia.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix schek Dios yal winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'an yip lum lum, yujto 70 ab'il manhxalaj mach ix munlaj t'a sat lu'um.

Ayik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, ix elk'och slolonel Jehová alb'ilkanel yuj winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Ha Jehová ix ak'an sna winhaj rey Ciro chi', yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun cheknab'il winh. Ix schekan winh alchajel t'a masanil yol smakb'en, ix schekanpax winh pukchaj hu'um, syalan icha tik:

Ha hin Ciro hin tik sreyal hin Persia, ha hin swal icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal satcha'anh, ha' ix ak'anoch masanil nación t'a sat lu'um tik t'a yol hin k'ab'. Ha' ix halan t'ayin to tzin b'ok'e skajnub' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol yik Judá. Yuj chi', yalnhej mach hex schonhab' hex Jehová, kolwajokab' Jehová he Diosal chi' heyet'ok. Ha tikne'ik meltzajanhek t'a Jerusalén chi', xchi winh.
